noResourceCost.label: No Recipe Resource Costs
noResourceCost.description: Removes direct ingredients, category ingredients and water charges from recipes before startup. Recipe requirements display as zero. Requires a game restart. Building, upgrade and other shared inventory costs are unchanged.

infiniteItemUse.label: Keep Used Items
infiniteItemUse.description: Prevents item consumption when actions pay their usage cost or apply buffs. Mana, stamina and fuel costs remain unchanged. Crafting ingredients and inventory transfers are unaffected.

productionTimeMode.label: Recipe Time Mode
productionTimeMode.description: Changing the mode requires a restart. Original recipe times use the live scale. Shared time changes every timed recipe during startup asset preparation.

options.fixed: Restart required: One shared time for all recipes

productionSeconds.label: Production Time in Seconds
productionSeconds.description: Sets one base duration for every timed recipe in shared-time mode. Applied during startup asset preparation. Requires restart.

workshopTimeFactorPercent.label: Production Duration Scale
workshopTimeFactorPercent.description: Applied live. At 0%, the shortest timed recipe is scaled to 1 second and other recipes keep their relative times. 100% preserves normal world speed. 200% doubles normal duration.

groups.label: Resources and Inventory
groups.description: Recipe ingredient and water costs are changed before startup. Keep Used Items controls supported action usage costs and buff application.

groups.label: Production
groups.description: Choose live scaling of original recipe times or one shared duration prepared at startup. Only the control for the selected mode is enabled.
